environment.browser: Headless Google Chrome through the repository CDP matrix harness
environment.actor: Synthetic authenticated owner named QA Owner
environment.credentials: Synthetic QA-only credentials generated by the harness; no user credentials or PIN were requested

requiredFields: signed quantity in the product base unit
ledgerContract.actorPolicy: Authenticated mutations use the request user identity; explicit background operations use KiranaOS system; historical nullable rows render as Legacy entry
ledgerContract.normalization: The client maps server changeBaseQty, before/after balance, source, unit, actor and time into the same contract as local-first rows
ledgerContract.transactionality: Provenance fields are written on the StockLedger row inside the owning stock mutation transaction
ledgerContract.idempotency: Existing source/event identities and mutation-specific replay controls remain authoritative; the UI merge keys server and local copies by durable movement identity

domains: direct purchase, damage, correction and manual sale
purchase order receipt and purchase return
restaurant recipe, add-on and combo consumption
writerCoverage.staticInvariant: backend/tests/stock-ledger-traceability.examples.js passed and rejects a schema or writer that omits the shared provenance contract

schemaAndMigrations.backwardCompatibility: Actor fields are nullable so historical stock rows remain readable without fabricated attribution

mobileUx.phone: Premium movement cards show product, movement/time, signed quantity/unit, before-to-after balance, actor, source/note and sync state
mobileUx.tabletDesktop: A labeled, keyboard-focusable horizontal trace region preserves the same fields in a dense table
mobileUx.navigation: Movement history is available from the labeled More actions surface; the back action and all visible controls meet the 44px contract
mobileUx.languages: English and Hindi labels are present; the synthetic source notes remain fixture-entered English text

visualEvidence.axeIncomplete: 8 total review-required color/overlap checks across both reports; these are not violations and are not represented as a full accessibility claim

qaDiscoveredFixes: Server changeBaseQty is normalized instead of rendering remote movement quantity as zero
The stock-history table is a named keyboard-focusable scroll region
Damage badges, trace metadata, labels, notes, sync pills and positive quantities meet automated AA contrast in the captured states
The stateful QA harness scrolls the More actions trigger into view and anchors evidence inside the application content scroller
limitations: This is local synthetic authenticated evidence, not an external production deployment or exact-candidate CI run
Historical rows created before the actor migration may have null actor fields and intentionally render as Legacy entry
Axe incomplete results require human review; no physical screen-reader, switch-control or real-device session is claimed
No real customer, supplier, inventory or credential data was used
releaseImpact: INV-002 is locally verified. The overall release remains NO-GO until the remaining roadmap, exact-candidate CI/deployment, hardware/provider, physical accessibility and named human approval gates are complete.
